<!--
A change: new behavior, a design change, or work that needs a plan before it needs code.
For something that is simply broken, use the Bug template instead.

This issue carries the WHY. The plan itself is a file on the change's branch, and its
final text goes in the pull request description, because the plan is what gets approved
and it should live next to the diff it describes. See CONTRIBUTING.md. This issue's
number is the change's number: the branch, the plan file and every commit carry it.
-->
